input_messages.content: Hi there! I was hoping you could help me with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check where it was sent, if it’s still on the way, and maybe give me the tracking number? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered for her. And, if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s address in Chicago, so I don’t have to change it every time.
I actually can’t remember the email I used, sorry about that. But my name is Lucas Santos, and my zip code is 80239. I live in Denver, Colorado. Would that be enough to find my order?

Thank you! I’m not sure which order number it is, but it’s the one that was supposed to go to my daughter in Chicago. Maybe you can check which one was shipped to Chicago? That’s the one I’m worried about.

As for her address, I can give you that. Do you need the full street address, or just the city and zip code for now?

Thank you for the info! That’s helpful, but my daughter says she hasn’t received anything yet, even though it says delivered. Is there any way to see where exactly it was delivered, or maybe who signed for it? Sometimes packages get left with neighbors or at the wrong door.

And sure, I can give you her full address. It’s 1842 W. Addison St, Apt 3B, Chicago, IL 60613.

By the way, thanks for helping me out with all this. I don’t have many people to talk to these days, so it’s nice to have someone to chat with, even if it’s just about a package.

Thank you for updating the address for me. I’ll reach out to the carrier and see if they can give me more details about the delivery. I just hope it turns up—my daughter was really looking forward to that tablet.

I appreciate you taking the time to help me out. Sometimes it feels like I’m bothering people with all these questions, but you’ve been really patient. Do you ever get people just wanting to chat, or is it usually just business?

Thank you, that means a lot. I’ll keep that in mind if I need help with anything else in the future. I guess I’ll go check with the carrier now and see if they can track down the package. Thanks again for your help and for listening. Have a good day! 

###STOP###
